[#hash-backends-of-argon2id]
.Who implements `argon2id` (RFC 9106, one lane)
[cols="2,1,2,2,3,1",options="header"]
|===
| Function | Backend | The program's Jamfile names | Targets | Hmacs | Constant time

| `argon2id`
| `sodium`
| `/third_party//sodium`
| native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten
| -
| not stated

| `argon2id`
| `openssl`
| `/webcpp/hash//openssl`
| native, wasip2, wasip3
| -
| not stated
|===

What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `openssl`: OpenSSL 3.5.9: doc/man7/EVP_KDF-ARGON2.pod states that Argon2i's memory accesses are independent of the data and Argon2d's depend on it, and states no constant-time property.
* `sodium`: libsodium 1.0.22: its headers state constant time for comparisons (sodium/utils.h) alone, not for its hashing, MAC, key derivation and password hashing functions (crypto_hash_*, crypto_xof_*, crypto_generichash_*, crypto_shorthash_*, crypto_auth_*, crypto_kdf_*, crypto_pwhash_*).

The default of `argon2id`: `sodium` on every target, whatever the program links; `openssl` only where the call names it, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).
